$comment: Where a template engine writes into an attribute's value before the browser reads it, in every HTML-side file whatever its engine: the analysis leaves these out of the checks, and VS Code's grammar for an HTML file (placeholders-html-injection) is written from this list. A construct opens with its opener and ends at its closer; a brace opener ends at the brace that balances it; a directive is its word and the condition in parentheses after it. Razor's @, and ${...} inside a JavaScript template in jte, FreeMarker and Velocity, are each engine's alone: see TemplateEngine.
